counterevidence.held: The dotted preview starts at the pulled stone and falls toward the ground on the right.
counterevidence.released: The released stone leaves the sling and flies right, close to the level of the sling. The drawn preview and the actual flight do not share an origin or a path.
counterevidence.source: The preview loop starts at the pulled position while the projectile spawns at the sling.

evaluationScope: The dotted preview against the launch that follows, for one pull. Do not infer full-game quality, content or finish, and do not require a particular visual style. Later levels, ammunition kinds and scoring are not shown.
